files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Abstractions.Attributes.CockroachDBComputedAttribute
files.Summary:
Marks an entity property as a CockroachDB computed (generated) column. CockroachDB requires computed columns to be STORED — virtual columns are not supported.

public class Order
{
    public int Price { get; set; }
    public int Quantity { get; set; }

    [CockroachDBComputed("price * quantity")]
    public int Total { get; set; }
}

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Abstractions.Attributes.FollowerReadStaleness
files.Summary: Additive follower-read staleness. The parts ADD UP and compose into a single AS OF SYSTEM TIME argument. All-zero (the default value) means "no explicit staleness" and uses follower_read_timestamp().

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Aegis.AegisExhaust
files.Summary:
Publishes application-side operational signals ("exhaust") to Cockroach Aegis.

The library sees app-attributed events — serialization retries, circuit trips — that the cluster alone cannot tie back to a specific service/method. Call these convenience methods from your retry/circuit hooks (or wire them into the metrics layer) to feed Aegis. Backed by any (the by default).

CockroachDB:Continuum:Aegis:Token    =

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Aegis.AppEvent
files.Summary: An application-side operational event published to Cockroach Aegis ("exhaust"). The library sees app intent + DB behavior the cluster alone cannot attribute (retry storms, circuit trips), so this feeds Aegis high-signal data.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Aegis.HttpAegisClient
files.Summary:
Placeholder for the real Cockroach Aegis HTTP client.

The Aegis API is not yet public, so every operation throws — callers never silently believe they are talking to a live Aegis. Use for development and tests.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Aegis.IAegisClient
files.Summary:
Client for Cockroach Aegis autonomous database operations.

Read-first: list findings/recommendations the agents produced. Also accepts application "exhaust" via so app-attributed signals can inform the agents.

Aegis is preview/EA and its API is not yet public. The default, fully-functional implementation is ; a real is stubbed until the API lands.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Aegis.McpAegisClient
files.Summary: Adapts an to . Aegis is reachable read-only over the Cockroach Continuum Cloud MCP server; this adapter calls the configured tools and parses their text content as JSON into /.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Aegis.McpToolNames
files.Summary: Maps Aegis operations to the tool names an MCP server advertises. The Cockroach Continuum MCP tool contract is not pinned here: names differ by server and may change. Discover them with and set the ones you need; an unset name throws rather than guessing.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Aegis.SimulatedAegisClient

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Agent.AgentToolAttribute
files.Summary: Exposes the annotated method as an agent-callable tool (e.g. for Cockroach Aegis or any MCP client). Only [AgentTool] methods are exposed, and tools are hidden unless the caller explicitly opts in — least privilege by default.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Agent.CrdbAgent
files.Summary:
Agent / MCP facade over [AgentTool]-annotated providers.

var agent = CrdbAgent.From(new CrdbOpsTools(dataSource, storageInsights));
var tools = agent.ListTools();                        // MCP tools/list
var result = await agent.InvokeAsync("health", null); // MCP tools/call

Least-privilege: destructive tools are excluded unless is enabled. A full MCP stdio/HTTP server is out of scope for this increment; adapt / onto your transport of choice.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Agent.CrdbOpsTools

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Mcp.HttpMcpClient
files.Summary: HTTP-backed speaking the MCP Streamable HTTP transport (spec 2025-06-18). Lazily performs the initialize handshake before the first tools call, echoes the server-assigned Mcp-Session-Id and the MCP-Protocol-Version header, and handles both application/json and text/event-stream responses. Responses are parsed with by field name. Construct with in production, or inject an backed by a fake handler in tests.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Plenum.StorageInsights
files.Summary:
Read-only Cockroach Plenum storage insights.

Surfaces usage-based storage signals — per-table estimated row counts and, where the running version exposes it, approximate on-disk size — using only customer-safe SHOW surfaces (never crdb_internal, which is restricted in v26.2). Version-tolerant: signals a given version does not expose are returned as null rather than raising, and any query failure degrades to an empty result instead of throwing the whole summary.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.Plenum.TableStorage

files.Summary: A vCluster-bound execution surface.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.VirtualClusterAttribute
files.Summary:
Tags the annotated method's work for a Cockroach vCluster so it is isolated on shared capacity. The vCluster name is applied as SET LOCAL application_name for the transaction, so the workload is attributable in the DB Console and logs.

Combine with to also assign a priority/QoS class.

Scope (v1): workload tagging. Routing to a distinct vCluster endpoint is platform-dependent and is not performed by the library. Because .NET has no runtime method interception here, the attribute is a declarative marker; the runtime application path is plus (or OnVirtualCluster(...)).

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.VirtualClusterBinding
files.Summary: An immutable Cockroach vCluster binding: a workload name and an optional priority. When is null only the application_name tag is applied.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.VirtualClusterCommands
files.Summary:
Shared helper that applies a Cockroach vCluster to a connection as transaction-scoped session settings. Both and integration tests use this exact code path so behavior is verified end-to-end.

SET LOCAL scopes the tags to the current transaction so pooled connections are not polluted for the next borrower.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.VirtualClusterContext
files.Summary: -based Cockroach vCluster context for programmatic use, mirroring RegionContext. When set, (and the OnVirtualCluster(...) execution wrapper) apply the tag/QoS to the transaction. Flows correctly across async/await continuations.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.VirtualClusterExecutorExtensions
files.Summary:
Fluent, programmatic Cockroach vCluster execution: mirrors the template's InRegion(...). Binds a vCluster name/priority for the duration of the operation so tags it.

await executor.OnVirtualCluster("analytics", WorkloadPriority.Low)
              .ExecuteAsync(() => repository.RunReportAsync());

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.VirtualClusterMiddleware
files.Summary:
Pipeline middleware that applies Cockroach vCluster workload tagging. Mirrors RegionMiddleware: when a binding is in scope (via the OnVirtualCluster(...) wrapper, , or a binding placed on the context) it opens a transaction and issues the SET LOCAL application_name / SET LOCAL default_transaction_quality_of_service statements so the workload is attributable, then proceeds.

Register with pipeline.UseVirtualCluster().

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.VirtualClusterScope
files.Summary: A disposable scope that restores the previous vCluster binding on dispose.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.WorkloadAttribute
files.Summary:
Assigns a Cockroach vCluster workload priority to the annotated method, mapped to CockroachDB admission-control quality-of-service and applied as SET LOCAL default_transaction_quality_of_service for the transaction.

Most useful alongside . Without a vCluster binding (attribute or programmatic ) there is nothing for the QoS to attach to.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.WorkloadPriority
files.Summary: Cockroach vCluster workload priority classes, mapped to CockroachDB admission-control quality-of-service values.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.Continuum.VCluster.WorkloadPriorityExtensions
files.Summary: Maps a to its CockroachDB default_transaction_quality_of_service value.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.EntityFramework.Migrations.CockroachDBHistoryRepository
files.Summary:
History repository for CockroachDB that disables migration database locking.

CockroachDB does not support PostgreSQL advisory locks (pg_advisory_lock) or LOCK TABLE statements. EF Core 10+ requires for concurrent migration safety. This implementation provides a no-op lock, relying on CockroachDB's SERIALIZABLE isolation for conflict handling.

Migration coordination should happen at the deployment level (e.g., single-pod deploy, migration job, deployment gate).

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.EntityFramework.Migrations.CockroachDBMigrationsSqlGenerator
files.Summary: Migration SQL generator for CockroachDB, extending Npgsql's PostgreSQL generator with CockroachDB-specific DDL overrides: computed columns (STORED only), JSON default fix, and unique_rowid() support.

files.Title: CockroachDB.DotNet.EntityFramework.Migrations.CockroachDBNoopDatabaseLock
files.Summary: No-op database lock for CockroachDB — advisory locks are not available.
